recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-3703 unless a future work group decision changes the general patient-vs-subject naming rule.
issue_request: FHIR-3703 was a Published/Persuasive PC change request for DSTU1 asking to rename FamilyHistory.subject to FamilyHistory.patient because Patient is the only reasonable target and the subject name is reserved for elements that may target other resource types.
initial_application: Git commit ae105ca24408da7f82d376f16c13eae4e4705ad6, dated 2014-11-17, changed FamilyHistory examples from <subject> to <patient>, changed the spreadsheet element row to FamilyHistory.patient, changed the search expression to FamilyHistory.patient, and recorded [#3703]. Later source refactors carried the committee note into the current StructureDefinition.
additional_context: The current build actively includes familymemberhistory as FamilyMemberHistory in source/fhir.ini and classifies it as a patient-compartment resource. The current StructureDefinition defines FamilyMemberHistory.patient as a required Reference(Patient), and the search parameter code/expression is patient/FamilyMemberHistory.patient. Source, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no stale FamilyHistory.subject or FamilyMemberHistory.subject definition and no conflicting later community evidence.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The existing active source already matches the Jira decision across the authoritative element definition, examples, and search parameter surface.
